entities.summary: Grigore Pintea, aka Pintea the Brave (Romanian: Pintea Viteazul; Hungarian: Pintye Vitéz; February 25, 1670 in Hollómező, Principality of Transylvania – August 14, 1703 in Nagybánya, Kingdom of Hungary, was a famous heroic haiduc stemming from Măgoaja, Lăpuș Country.
